reasons.no_model_installed: No model is installed for this kind of work.
reasons.backend_not_configured: Nothing is set up to render this kind of work.
reasons.llm_server_down: The program that runs language models isn't running.
reasons.llm_model_missing: The program that runs language models doesn't have "{model}".
reasons.cloud_key_missing: No {provider} API key is set for "{model}".
reasons.cloud_model_unknown: No provider offers "{model}" for this kind of work.
reasons.comfyui_down: The program that draws images and video isn't running.
reasons.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg, the tool that puts the video together, wasn't found.
reasons.ffmpeg_cannot_draw_text: This machine's FFmpeg can't draw text onto the video.
reasons.install_path_too_long: LocalCut AI is installed in a folder whose path is too long for espeak-ng, the tool that turns narration text into speech sounds.

effects.placeholder: a stand-in, not the real thing
effects.stillClip: still images with a slow push-in
effects.otherModel: rendered by a different installed model

dialog.title: Before you render
dialog.intro_one: You can still render, but one stage won't turn out right:
dialog.intro_other: You can still render, but {count} stages won't turn out right:
dialog.clear: Nothing stands in the way of this render now.

scopeHint.session: Quiet until you close the app.
scopeHint.always: Never warn again. Settings → General turns it back on.

programs.setupTipHint: Downloaded into LocalCut AI's data folder on the machine the engine runs on. Nothing outside that folder changes.
programs.cancelTipHint: Stops the setup and deletes what it downloaded

reasons.size_mismatch: the file that arrived wasn't the size it should be.
reasons.checksum_mismatch: the file that arrived didn't match its checksum.
reasons.does_not_run: the copy it downloaded doesn't run on the engine's machine.
reasons.in_use: another program has LocalCut AI's copy open. Close it and try again.
reasons.install_failed: it couldn't be moved into place.
